assembly_contracts.S01: Two independent protected channels, pump12V and valve24V, upstream of command outputs and behind S02 cutoffs. Pump load contract: <=1A continuous, <=1.5A/60ms startup, <=470uF; current-limit1.752–2.268A, total pump source/wiring/shunt impedance<=0.30ohm, output rise about20ms, output discharge47ohm equivalent and <=1V within120ms after disable. Valve cold current<=0.60A, L<=10H; channel limit0.705–0.913A; unidirectional coil switching and suppression energy>=5J, reverse coil clamp<=30V, switching device>=100V with peak drain<80V. Current/power limiting failure latches; no automatic retry. Regulated pass power12–25W, timeout20–60ms, case<=75C, transient overshoot<=8A for<=20us at VDS<=30V; source/choke/damping design must demonstrate that bound. Separate actual load-voltage feedback, isolated current channels and power-good/fault outputs; insertion delay<=1.1s and ready-low/fresh-permit interlock supplied; a command is not feedback. Include input inrush/hot-plug protection, reverse/backfeed protection, appropriate inductive clamps and power-off behavior. Reference controller LM5069-1 (latched version), reference linear-rated pass device IXTK90N25L2; reference Rs27.4mohm/68.1mohm1%, CT680nF5%; adjust complete design to actual thresholds, PWR resistor, gate charge and PCB. Main/regulated and short-overshoot waveforms must be checked against actual datasheet FBSOA at75C, not avalanche energy or headline wattage. Entire internal BOM/design/assembly/test supplied; reference values are not a standalone construction circuit.
assembly_contracts.S02: Two-channel E-stop and monitored edge RESET. Reset allowed only when permit is low, all E-stop/STOP/pressure/low-level/leak/thermal/vacuum-admission/field-power inputs are healthy, hardware heartbeat10Hz has at least two edges, and both cutoffs are proved open by mirror/forcibly guided contacts. Hardware watchdog detection<=200ms plus cutoff contact release<=40ms; complete missing/static-heartbeat-to-power-removal<=250ms including internal sampling/jitter. Record measured factory timings. Two independent normally-open power cutoffs K1/K2 in series with BOTH12V pump and24V valve positive rails; 24V coils, each with adequate documented DC-inductive rating (>=3A at24V for this bounded load) and EDM contacts. E-stop/pressure/leak/water/thermal faults drop actuator authority; no Pi, agent or network required. One welded cutoff is contained by the other and prevents reset. Supply restore, E-stop release or held RESET never restarts. Reset first arms the cutoffs with permit LOW; then wait up to1.1s for S01 initial insertion/READY. S01 READY is not a prerequisite for closing its upstream cutoffs. Only after READY has been observed with permit LOW may a fresh rising execution permit enable outputs. Early/held permit must not start upon READY. A READY timeout or loss during execution trips; a fresh reviewed application approval remains required. Separate permanent power feeds keep Pi and instrumentation recording during a trip. Supply a true hardware implementation and factory fault tests; this contract/model is not a claim of SIL/PL certification for the assembled bench.
assembly_contracts.S03: Field bus powered5V; host I2C3.3V isolated, <=100kHz, host cable<=0.3m. Host-off leakage<=1uA per signal; no direct field5/24V connection to Pi pins. Two ADS1115-class16bit ADCs atfield4.5–5.2V, addresses0x48/0x49; pressure, two load voltages and two Hall currents, with a separate supervised flow window/counter. Deliver >=100 timestamped samples/s per pressure/current/load-voltage channel, actual conversion order/delay and uncertainty included. Choose conversion scheduling/gain so aggregate rate is feasible; no simultaneous-sampling claim. Pressure input0–33mA: loop protector36V with DC limit<=33mA,100ohm0.1%>=0.5W shunt, input-fault clamp, protected sense input. Include full-network scaling/calibration. Analog signals reaching powered-off input switches<=3.6V; power-good opens all affected signal paths within50us, while local isolated hold-up>=100uF with load<=20mA retains ADC rail margin. Two galvanically isolated bidirectional Hall current channels, +/-5A range, >=1kHz bandwidth, calibrated uncertainty<=0.05A over0–2.5A; each conductor/sensor rated>=5A DC, isolation and connector ratings supplied. Locate in actual load conductor; valve placement includes flyback current path when feasible. Pump differential load-voltage range0–18V, valve-30..+30V including flyback, conditioner common-mode withstand>=60V. Shift/scale to protected ADC input range0–3.3V; include gain/offset calibration and overrange indication. No INA226 common-mode assumption during negative flyback. Hall0.5–4.5V output must be scaled nominally0.65 to0.325–2.925V before protected ADC. Suggested calibrated voltage transfers: pump0.15+0.16xVload (0–18V), valve1.65+0.05xVload (-30..+30V); supplier proves actual topology/CM range and timing. Actual current/voltage inputs separate from commands; values/quality/source timestamps and saturation must be preserved. Pressure/current/voltage source age<=200ms; temperature age<=2s; counter heartbeat<=100ms and stale after200ms. Zero pulse frequency is valid when acquisition is healthy. Missing flow response after3s with command ON or CLOSED feedback disagreement beyond1s trips under the reviewed procedure; commissioning must establish expected current bands. Supervise NPN flow line with remote10kohmEOL plus2.2kohm series sensor resistor, controller4.7kohm pullup, window comparator/ADC with ratio bandsLOW0.250–0.295,HIGH0.655–0.705; open/short/24V miswire are invalid. Statically low OR high can be valid zero. Hardware pulse counter>=32bit,>=5kHz capability; field timestamp/sequence/heartbeat at<=100ms, reset detectable, read-only register contract at0x42. Counter firmware/source/protocol included and has no actuator authority. At least two4-channel power-off-protected analog switches (reference TMUX1511) or a documented equivalent protect every affected ADC input; pressure/voltage/current sources remain isolated on field power loss. All analog conditioners/clamps/line terminations, digital isolators, field5V converter, power-off protections, plugs and labels included.
